understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spike tiles and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions shift the player, after which gravity carries them until they land, hit a hazard, or reach the goal. Gravity direction determines whether falling proceeds toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK at a target position removes clickable breakable blocks without moving the player, allowing new fall paths. Landing on spikes ends the attempt; each level provides two attempts and a turn limit. UNDO reverts the previous action. The landing previews and corridor scan indicate safe destinations and passage columns to prioritize.
